Here is the test suite in Decision Tables notation, followed by the corresponding JSON test cases:

```artifact
| Requirement ID | Condition | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| REQ003 | Linkable text exists | Generate unique and permanent identifier |
| REQ003 | Linkable text does not exist | Error: Linkable text not found |
| REQ004 | Formatting is requested | Apply formatting to linkable text |
| REQ004 | Formatting is not requested | Do not apply formatting to linkable text |
| REQ001 | External requirements asset exists | Store external requirements asset |
| REQ001 | External requirements asset does not exist | Error: External requirements asset not found |
| REQ016 | Content from other requirements management tool exists | Import content from other requirements management tool |
| REQ016 | Content from other requirements management tool does not exist | Error: Content not found |
| REQ017 | Content to export exists | Export content to interact with common text/document tools |
| REQ017 | Content to export does not exist | Error: Content not found |
| REQ007 | Requirements document exists | View requirements as a document |
| REQ007 | Requirements document does not exist | Error: Requirements document not found |
| REQ008 | Document item exists | View document item interactively |
| REQ008 | Document item does not exist | Error: Document item not found |
| REQ009 | Baseline version exists | Baseline version of requirements |
| REQ009 | Baseline version does not exist | Error: Baseline version not found |
| REQ003 | Identifier already exists | Error: Identifier already exists |
| REQ004 | Invalid formatting request | Error: Invalid formatting request |
| REQ001 | Invalid external requirements asset | Error: Invalid external requirements asset |
| REQ016 | Invalid content from other requirements management tool | Error: Invalid content |
| REQ017 | Invalid content to export | Error: Invalid content |
| REQ007 | Invalid requirements document | Error: Invalid requirements document |
| REQ008 | Invalid document item | Error: Invalid document item |
| REQ009 | Invalid baseline version | Error: Invalid baseline version |
```
